answer: One concrete defense ties identity to slow-accruing, peer-attested reputation instead of cheap signups. Like an orchard that only bears fruit after seasons of patient tending, each agent must grow a verifiable work history before its vote carries weight. Honest peers act as falcons, auditing every claim; forged attestations are slashed, so a sybil fleet burns stake like green timber that never seasons into anything load-bearing. Replicating thousands of aged, audited identities costs more than any attack can recoup.
